text:
Aisha R: Hey folks 144b just finished Kandji enroll but hitting a security block when trying to enable our corp VPN (WireGuard) and install Rosetta for some vendor tools. System prompts say "System extensions blocked" and in Security & Privacy it shows a message to "Allow" the developer, but the padlock is greyed out so i cant unlock.
IT Support: welcome Aisha! Kandji normally manages the system-extension approval for enrolled devices. Can you paste the exact message from Settings > Privacy & Security (screenshot link also fine)?
Aisha R: pasted screenshot: https://img.internal/snap/1915310000.png. Text: "A system extension by 'Corp VPN Vendor' was blocked. Click Allow to enable it." padlock is greyed, button disabled. Also when i try `arch -x86_64 /usr/local/bin/brew install some-old-cli` it fails with "permission denied" because sudo is disabled for my account.
Maria L: @Aisha R Im IT on rotation. Kandji policy for new hires disables local admin and auto-approves a whitelisted set of system extensions. Looks like this vendor's kernel extension wasn't whitelisted yet. We can do a remote push to approve it, or temporarily elevate you to admin to click Allow. Which do you prefer?
Aisha R: remote push would be great so it's reproducible. Ill need Rosetta too (some tools only ship x86). If elevation is faster we can do that temporarily.
Rafael G: Aisha is on my team and needs VPN to access internal repos. If temporary admin is needed go ahead for 60 minutes.
DevEx Bot: Ticket created: IT-9850  Approve system extension for 'Corp VPN Vendor' and temporary Rosetta enablement requested for Aisha R. Approver: Maria L. Approve: https://internal.ticket/IT-9850
IT Support: pushing whitelist for the vendor now via Kandji. This may take ~2-3 mins. After the push, reboot once and then check Settings > Privacy & Security for the Allow button to become active (sometimes macOS still requires a manual Allow but Kandji can pre-approve).
Aisha R: rebooted, still shows the blocked message but the Allow button is now clickable. Clicked Allow, restarted VPN installer. Installer now continues to the onboarding flow. Thanks!
Sam P: FYI for Rosetta: run `softwareupdate --install-rosetta --agree-to-license` after admin elevation (or IT can push it). Also if you need temporary sudo for builds, we do 60m sessions. Please share the commands you run so we can add them to the Kandji script for future hires.
Aisha R: Will do. Steps I needed: 1) kandji whitelist push from IT 2) reboot 3) open Settings > Privacy & Security > Allow (click) 4) IT pushed rosetta install; then `brew install --cask docker ; brew install mysql` 5) un-elevate account. I'll drop a short runbook in #devex-setup. :memo:
Maria L: thanks for the runbook. Closing ticket IT-9850 now. If anything else pops up ping IT and we can do a scheduled session to fix lingering SIP/profile issues. :white_check_mark:
